english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 27th June 2022 due to changes made by section 86 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022, which increased the penalty on indictment from 14 years imprisonment to, life imprisonment. For the offence applying before the 26th June 2022, see H10172. For offences applying before 26th February 2004, see H3250.
(ii) The minimum period of obligatory disqualification for this offence under section 34 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 was increased by section 86 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022. See section 34(3), 34(3A) and 34(4ZA) which in some cases, increases the disqualification period to ten year or five years.
(iii) For the purposes of section 3A, a person is taken to be unfit to drive at any time when his/her ability to drive properly is impaired.
(iv) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(v) Officers should ensure that they know the CPS Guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges.
